properties.name: Barren River Lake State Resort Park
properties.title: Barren River Lake State Resort Park
properties.history: Resort park on the north shore of Barren River Lake in south-central Kentucky. The lodge, cottages, and marina anchor boating, fishing, and golf on one of the region’s major Corps lakes. Visitors use it as a base for lake recreation and nearby Mammoth Cave country drives.
properties.description: Resort park on the north shore of Barren River Lake in south-central Kentucky. The lodge, cottages, and marina anchor boating, fishing, and golf on one of the region’s major Corps lakes. Visitors use it as a base for lake recreation and nearby Mammoth Cave country drives.

properties.name: Big Bone Lick State Historic Site
properties.title: Big Bone Lick State Historic Site
properties.history: Called the birthplace of American vertebrate paleontology for Ice Age bones found at its salt lick. Trails, a museum, and outdoor bison herd interpret prehistoric and frontier natural history. Northern Kentucky visitors reach it about 30–40 minutes south of Cincinnati.
properties.description: Called the birthplace of American vertebrate paleontology for Ice Age bones found at its salt lick. Trails, a museum, and outdoor bison herd interpret prehistoric and frontier natural history. Northern Kentucky visitors reach it about 30–40 minutes south of Cincinnati.

properties.name: Blue Licks Battlefield State Resort Park
properties.title: Blue Licks Battlefield State Resort Park
properties.history: Marks the August 1782 Battle of Blue Licks, often called the last major Revolutionary War battle in Kentucky. Salt springs once drew bison, Native hunters, and pioneers; today a museum, battlefield trail, and lodge interpret that frontier story. The park pairs history with camping and short nature walks.

properties.name: Breaks Interstate Park
properties.title: Breaks Interstate Park
properties.history: Joint Kentucky–Virginia park protecting the “Grand Canyon of the South,” a deep gorge of the Russell Fork. Lodge lodging, overlooks, and river trails draw visitors to the Pike County–Buchanan County border. Though administered under an interstate compact, it is commonly listed with Kentucky’s resort parks.

properties.name: Buckhorn Lake State Resort Park
properties.title: Buckhorn Lake State Resort Park
properties.history: Quiet mountain resort on Buckhorn Lake in the eastern Kentucky coalfields. Lodge rooms and cottages overlook a forested Corps reservoir popular for fishing and pontoon boating. The park is a low-key base for exploring Perry County and nearby Daniel Boone National Forest roads.
properties.description: Quiet mountain resort on Buckhorn Lake in the eastern Kentucky coalfields. The park is a low-key base for exploring Perry County and nearby Daniel Boone National Forest roads.

properties.name: Carr Creek State Park
properties.title: Carr Creek State Park
properties.history: Recreation park on Carr Creek Lake in Knott County. Camping, a beach, and boat ramps serve eastern Kentucky lake weekends. The setting is classic Appalachian ridge-and-hollow country around a Corps reservoir.
properties.description: Recreation park on Carr Creek Lake in Knott County. Camping, a beach, and boat ramps serve eastern Kentucky lake weekends. The setting is classic Appalachian ridge-and-hollow country around a Corps reservoir.

properties.name: Carter Caves State Resort Park
properties.title: Carter Caves State Resort Park
properties.history: Cave-and-ridge park in northeastern Kentucky with guided tours of Cascade and X Cave and miles of surface trails. Lodge and cottages sit among wooded karst country near the Ohio River hills. Equestrian camping and a small lake round out a classic Kentucky resort-park stay.
properties.description: Cave-and-ridge park in northeastern Kentucky with guided tours of Cascade and X Cave and miles of surface trails. Lodge and cottages sit among wooded karst country near the Ohio River hills. Equestrian camping and a small lake round out a classic Kentucky resort-park stay.

properties.name: Columbus-Belmont State Park
properties.title: Columbus-Belmont State Park
properties.history: Civil War bluff park overlooking the Mississippi River at Columbus. Confederate fortifications, a massive anchor-and-chain display, and museum exhibits interpret the 1861–62 river war. Picnic areas and overlooks make it a western Kentucky history stop.
properties.description: Civil War bluff park overlooking the Mississippi River at Columbus. Confederate fortifications, a massive anchor-and-chain display, and museum exhibits interpret the 1861–62 river war. Picnic areas and overlooks make it a western Kentucky history stop.

properties.name: Cumberland Falls State Resort Park
properties.title: Cumberland Falls State Resort Park
properties.history: Home of Cumberland Falls—the “Niagara of the South”—and one of the few places in the Western Hemisphere where a moonbow can appear under a full moon. Historic DuPont Lodge and Riverview Restaurant overlook the Cumberland River gorge (lodge dining closed for renovations as of late 2025–2026). Trails, cabins, and falls overlooks remain signature park experiences.

properties.name: Dale Hollow Lake State Resort Park
properties.title: Dale Hollow Lake State Resort Park
properties.history: Kentucky’s resort foothold on vast Dale Hollow Lake along the Tennessee border. Clear water, smallmouth bass fishing, and marina access draw boaters to the lodge and cottages. Island View Restaurant’s glass walls look out over the lake and forested shoreline.
properties.description: Kentucky’s resort foothold on vast Dale Hollow Lake along the Tennessee border. Clear water, smallmouth bass fishing, and marina access draw boaters to the lodge and cottages. Island View Restaurant’s glass walls look out over the lake and forested shoreline.

properties.name: Dawkins Line Rail Trail
properties.title: Dawkins Line Rail Trail
properties.history: Multi-use rail-trail on the former Dawkins Line through Johnson and Magoffin counties in eastern Kentucky. Hikers, cyclists, and equestrians follow converted railroad grade through Appalachian countryside. Trailheads and segments remain part of the Kentucky State Parks recreation inventory.
properties.description: Multi-use rail-trail on the former Dawkins Line through Johnson and Magoffin counties in eastern Kentucky. properties.name: Dr. Thomas Walker State Historic Site
properties.title: Dr. Thomas Walker State Historic Site
properties.history: Replica of the cabin associated with Dr. Thomas Walker, who explored Kentucky through Cumberland Gap in 1750. Picnic grounds and a short interpretive stop sit near Barbourville. The site honors one of the earliest documented English explorations of the region.
properties.description: Replica of the cabin associated with Dr. Thomas Walker, who explored Kentucky through Cumberland Gap in 1750. Picnic grounds and a short interpretive stop sit near Barbourville. The site honors one of the earliest documented English explorations of the region.

properties.name: E. P. "Tom" Sawyer State Park
properties.title: E. P. "Tom" Sawyer State Park
properties.history: Urban state park in northeast Louisville with trails, sports fields, a model airplane field, and community programming. Named for Jefferson County judge/executive E. P. “Tom” Sawyer. It is the system’s primary metro Louisville day-use park.
properties.description: Urban state park in northeast Louisville with trails, sports fields, a model airplane field, and community programming. Named for Jefferson County judge/executive E. P. “Tom” Sawyer. It is the system’s primary metro Louisville day-use park.

properties.name: Fort Boonesborough State Park
properties.title: Fort Boonesborough State Park
properties.history: Living-history fort on the Kentucky River at the site of Daniel Boone’s 1775 settlement. Reconstructed blockhouses, artisan demos, and a museum interpret Transylvania Company frontier life. Campground and river access support overnight stays near Richmond.
properties.description: Living-history fort on the Kentucky River at the site of Daniel Boone’s 1775 settlement. Reconstructed blockhouses, artisan demos, and a museum interpret Transylvania Company frontier life. Campground and river access support overnight stays near Richmond.

properties.name: General Burnside Island State Park
properties.title: General Burnside Island State Park
properties.history: Island park in Lake Cumberland at Burnside, named for Civil War general Ambrose Burnside. Golf, camping, and lake access make it a southern Kentucky recreation hub. The island setting is unique among Kentucky state parks.
properties.description: Island park in Lake Cumberland at Burnside, named for Civil War general Ambrose Burnside. Golf, camping, and lake access make it a southern Kentucky recreation hub. The island setting is unique among Kentucky state parks.

properties.name: General Butler State Resort Park
properties.title: General Butler State Resort Park
properties.history: Hilltop resort where the Kentucky River meets the Ohio near Carrollton. Named for Gen. William Orlando Butler, the park mixes lodge lodging, a ski slope in season, and the Butler-Turpin historic house. Two Rivers Restaurant serves park guests overlooking the river confluence country.

properties.name: Grayson Lake State Park
properties.title: Grayson Lake State Park
properties.history: Camping and boating park on Grayson Lake in Carter County. Steep sandstone cliffs and clear water attract anglers and paddlers. The park is a quieter sister to nearby Carter Caves resort amenities.
properties.description: Camping and boating park on Grayson Lake in Carter County. Steep sandstone cliffs and clear water attract anglers and paddlers. The park is a quieter sister to nearby Carter Caves resort amenities.

properties.name: Green River Lake State Park
properties.title: Green River Lake State Park
properties.history: Large recreation park on Green River Lake near Campbellsville. Campground, beach, and marina support one of central Kentucky’s major Corps lakes. It is a frequent stop for fishing tournaments and family lake weekends.
properties.description: Large recreation park on Green River Lake near Campbellsville. Campground, beach, and marina support one of central Kentucky’s major Corps lakes. It is a frequent stop for fishing tournaments and family lake weekends.

properties.name: Greenbo Lake State Resort Park
properties.title: Greenbo Lake State Resort Park
properties.history: Wooded resort on Greenbo Lake in northeastern Kentucky near the Ohio River. Michael Tygart Lodge and Angler's Cove dining cater to anglers and hikers using the park’s trails and lake. The setting is a quiet contrast to the industrial Ohio River corridor nearby.
properties.description: Wooded resort on Greenbo Lake in northeastern Kentucky near the Ohio River. Michael Tygart Lodge and Angler's Cove dining cater to anglers and hikers using the park’s trails and lake. The setting is a quiet contrast to the industrial Ohio River corridor nearby.

properties.name: Isaac Shelby Cemetery State Historic Site
properties.title: Isaac Shelby Cemetery State Historic Site
properties.history: Final resting place of Isaac Shelby, Kentucky’s first and fifth governor and a Revolutionary War leader. The small cemetery historic site near Junction City is a quiet stop on Bluegrass history routes. Interpretive markers place Shelby in the state’s founding story.
properties.description: Final resting place of Isaac Shelby, Kentucky’s first and fifth governor and a Revolutionary War leader. The small cemetery historic site near Junction City is a quiet stop on Bluegrass history routes. Interpretive markers place Shelby in the state’s founding story.

properties.name: Jefferson Davis State Historic Site
properties.title: Jefferson Davis State Historic Site
properties.history: Obelisk and visitor center at the birthplace of Jefferson Davis in Fairview. The 351-foot concrete monument dominates the Todd County landscape and interprets Davis’s Kentucky origins. The site is a major Civil War–era landmark on the western Kentucky driving circuit.
properties.description: Obelisk and visitor center at the birthplace of Jefferson Davis in Fairview. The 351-foot concrete monument dominates the Todd County landscape and interprets Davis’s Kentucky origins. The site is a major Civil War–era landmark on the western Kentucky driving circuit.

properties.name: Jenny Wiley State Resort Park
properties.title: Jenny Wiley State Resort Park
properties.history: Mountain resort on Dewey Lake named for frontier captive Jenny Wiley. May Lodge overlooks pines and water; Music Highway Grill and Dewey’s Lounge serve lodge guests and day visitors. Elk-viewing tours, amphitheater shows, and hiking make it a flagship eastern Kentucky park.

properties.name: John James Audubon State Park
properties.title: John James Audubon State Park
properties.history: Museum and nature park in Henderson honoring artist-naturalist John James Audubon, who lived and worked here. Trails circle woodland lakes; the museum holds significant Audubon art and bird specimens. Cottages and camping extend stays along the Ohio River corridor.
properties.description: Museum and nature park in Henderson honoring artist-naturalist John James Audubon, who lived and worked here. Trails circle woodland lakes; the museum holds significant Audubon art and bird specimens. Cottages and camping extend stays along the Ohio River corridor.

properties.name: Kenlake State Resort Park
properties.title: Kenlake State Resort Park
properties.history: Western Kentucky resort on Kentucky Lake in the Land Between the Lakes region. Lodge rooms, cottages, tennis, and a beach support long lake weekends. Aurora Landing is the onsite restaurant for breakfast through dinner service.
properties.description: Western Kentucky resort on Kentucky Lake in the Land Between the Lakes region. Lodge rooms, cottages, tennis, and a beach support long lake weekends. Aurora Landing is the onsite restaurant for breakfast through dinner service.

properties.name: Kentucky Dam Village State Resort Park
properties.title: Kentucky Dam Village State Resort Park
properties.history: Large resort village at the head of Kentucky Lake near Kentucky Dam. Golf, marina slips, lodge rooms, and cottages make it one of the system’s busiest western parks. Harbor Lights restaurant serves lodge and day visitors overlooking the lake corridor.
properties.description: Large resort village at the head of Kentucky Lake near Kentucky Dam. Golf, marina slips, lodge rooms, and cottages make it one of the system’s busiest western parks. Harbor Lights restaurant serves lodge and day visitors overlooking the lake corridor.

properties.name: Kincaid Lake State Park
properties.title: Kincaid Lake State Park
properties.history: Northern Kentucky lake park near Falmouth with camping, a beach, and boat rentals. Wooded hills surround a quiet reservoir popular with Cincinnati-area day-trippers. Trails and picnic areas fill out a classic recreation-park visit.
properties.description: Northern Kentucky lake park near Falmouth with camping, a beach, and boat rentals. Wooded hills surround a quiet reservoir popular with Cincinnati-area day-trippers. Trails and picnic areas fill out a classic recreation-park visit.

properties.name: Kingdom Come State Park
properties.title: Kingdom Come State Park
properties.history: Kentucky’s highest state park, atop Pine Mountain near Cumberland in Harlan County. Raven Rock and Log Rock overlooks, a tiny lake, and hiking define the highland experience. The name nods to John Fox Jr.’s novel The Little Shepherd of Kingdom Come.
properties.description: Kentucky’s highest state park, atop Pine Mountain near Cumberland in Harlan County. Raven Rock and Log Rock overlooks, a tiny lake, and hiking define the highland experience. The name nods to John Fox Jr.’s novel The Little Shepherd of Kingdom Come.

properties.name: Lake Barkley State Resort Park
properties.title: Lake Barkley State Resort Park
properties.history: Lodge resort on Lake Barkley opposite the Land Between the Lakes National Recreation Area. Floor-to-ceiling windows at Windows on the Water frame pine shoreline and open water. Marina, trails, and cottages support multi-day lake trips in western Kentucky.
properties.description: Lodge resort on Lake Barkley opposite the Land Between the Lakes National Recreation Area. Floor-to-ceiling windows at Windows on the Water frame pine shoreline and open water. Marina, trails, and cottages support multi-day lake trips in western Kentucky.

properties.name: Lake Cumberland State Resort Park
properties.title: Lake Cumberland State Resort Park
properties.history: Resort on sprawling Lake Cumberland, famous for houseboats and deep fishing holes. Lure Lodge and Rowena Landing restaurant sit above the water with marina access nearby. The park is a primary public gateway to one of Kentucky’s largest reservoirs.
properties.description: Resort on sprawling Lake Cumberland, famous for houseboats and deep fishing holes. Lure Lodge and Rowena Landing restaurant sit above the water with marina access nearby. The park is a primary public gateway to one of Kentucky’s largest reservoirs.

properties.name: Lake Malone State Park
properties.title: Lake Malone State Park
properties.history: Small recreation park on Lake Malone in Muhlenberg County. Sandstone cliffs, a beach, and camping draw western Kentucky weekenders. The lake is known for clear water and quiet fishing coves.
properties.description: Small recreation park on Lake Malone in Muhlenberg County. Sandstone cliffs, a beach, and camping draw western Kentucky weekenders. The lake is known for clear water and quiet fishing coves.

properties.name: Lincoln Homestead State Park
properties.title: Lincoln Homestead State Park
properties.history: Interprets the Lincoln family’s Kentucky roots near Springfield, including replicas of Thomas Lincoln’s workshop and Mordecai Lincoln’s house. A museum and 18-hole golf course share the grounds. It complements nearby Hodgenville’s national Lincoln birthplace sites.
properties.description: Interprets the Lincoln family’s Kentucky roots near Springfield, including replicas of Thomas Lincoln’s workshop and Mordecai Lincoln’s house. A museum and 18-hole golf course share the grounds. It complements nearby Hodgenville’s national Lincoln birthplace sites.

properties.name: Mineral Mound State Park
properties.title: Mineral Mound State Park
properties.history: Golf-and-lake park on a bluff above Lake Barkley near Eddyville. The site recalls the former mansion of Kentucky governor Willis D. Green’s era mineral-mound estate. Fairways and lake views are the main visitor draw.
properties.description: Golf-and-lake park on a bluff above Lake Barkley near Eddyville. The site recalls the former mansion of Kentucky governor Willis D. Green’s era mineral-mound estate. Fairways and lake views are the main visitor draw.

properties.name: My Old Kentucky Home State Park
properties.title: My Old Kentucky Home State Park
properties.history: Preserves Federal Hill, the Rowan family mansion that inspired Stephen Foster’s “My Old Kentucky Home.” Guided mansion tours, gardens, and the outdoor Stephen Foster Story amphitheater anchor Bardstown visits. The park is one of Kentucky’s most visited historic recreation sites.
properties.description: Preserves Federal Hill, the Rowan family mansion that inspired Stephen Foster’s “My Old Kentucky Home.” Guided mansion tours, gardens, and the outdoor Stephen Foster Story amphitheater anchor Bardstown visits. The park is one of Kentucky’s most visited historic recreation sites.

properties.name: Natural Bridge State Resort Park
properties.title: Natural Bridge State Resort Park
properties.history: Centered on a 65-foot-high sandstone arch and trail network at the edge of the Red River Gorge. Hemlock Lodge and Sandstone Arches Restaurant overlook wooded cliffs; a seasonal skylift shortens the climb to the bridge. The park is a classic gateway for gorge hiking, rock formations, and fall color drives in Powell and Estill county country.

properties.name: Nolin Lake State Park
properties.title: Nolin Lake State Park
properties.history: Camping park on Nolin Lake just north of Mammoth Cave National Park. Boat ramps and a beach serve a large Corps reservoir in the karst region. Many visitors pair lake time with cave tours a short drive south.
properties.description: Camping park on Nolin Lake just north of Mammoth Cave National Park. Boat ramps and a beach serve a large Corps reservoir in the karst region. Many visitors pair lake time with cave tours a short drive south.

properties.name: Old Fort Harrod State Park
properties.title: Old Fort Harrod State Park
properties.history: Full-scale reconstruction of Kentucky’s first permanent settlement (1774) in Harrodsburg. Cabin exhibits, the Mansion Museum, and pioneer cemetery interpret early Bluegrass frontier life. The park is a cornerstone stop on central Kentucky history drives.
properties.description: Full-scale reconstruction of Kentucky’s first permanent settlement (1774) in Harrodsburg. Cabin exhibits, the Mansion Museum, and pioneer cemetery interpret early Bluegrass frontier life. The park is a cornerstone stop on central Kentucky history drives.

properties.name: Old Mulkey Meetinghouse State Historic Site
properties.title: Old Mulkey Meetinghouse State Historic Site
properties.history: Preserves a 1804 log meetinghouse, among Kentucky’s oldest, near Tompkinsville. Pioneer graves and the simple sanctuary recall early Baptist frontier worship. The site is a short stop in southern Kentucky near the Tennessee line.
properties.description: Preserves a 1804 log meetinghouse, among Kentucky’s oldest, near Tompkinsville. Pioneer graves and the simple sanctuary recall early Baptist frontier worship. The site is a short stop in southern Kentucky near the Tennessee line.

properties.name: Paintsville Lake State Park
properties.title: Paintsville Lake State Park
properties.history: Marina and camping park on Paintsville Lake in Johnson County. Steep forested shores and clear water attract eastern Kentucky boaters. The park pairs well with nearby Jenny Wiley resort amenities and Mountain Parkway drives.
properties.description: Marina and camping park on Paintsville Lake in Johnson County. Steep forested shores and clear water attract eastern Kentucky boaters. The park pairs well with nearby Jenny Wiley resort amenities and Mountain Parkway drives.

properties.name: Pennyrile Forest State Resort Park
properties.title: Pennyrile Forest State Resort Park
properties.history: Resort tucked inside Pennyrile State Forest in western Kentucky. A small lake, lodge, cottages, and Clifty Creek Restaurant support hiking and quiet lake days. The surrounding forest is one of the Commonwealth’s larger state forest tracts.
properties.description: Resort tucked inside Pennyrile State Forest in western Kentucky. A small lake, lodge, cottages, and Clifty Creek Restaurant support hiking and quiet lake days. The surrounding forest is one of the Commonwealth’s larger state forest tracts.

properties.name: Perryville Battlefield State Historic Site
properties.title: Perryville Battlefield State Historic Site
properties.history: Preserves the core of Kentucky’s largest Civil War battle (October 8, 1862). Museum exhibits, monuments, and walking trails interpret the Confederate heartland offensive’s climax. Annual reenactments and quiet fields make it essential Bluegrass Civil War terrain.
properties.description: Preserves the core of Kentucky’s largest Civil War battle (October 8, 1862). Museum exhibits, monuments, and walking trails interpret the Confederate heartland offensive’s climax. Annual reenactments and quiet fields make it essential Bluegrass Civil War terrain.

properties.name: Pine Mountain State Resort Park
properties.title: Pine Mountain State Resort Park
properties.history: Kentucky’s first state park (1924), perched on Pine Mountain above Pineville. Herndon J. Evans Lodge and Mountain View Restaurant face long Appalachian valley views. Chained Rock, hiking trails, and mountain cottages define the historic mountain-resort experience.
properties.description: Kentucky’s first state park (1924), perched on Pine Mountain above Pineville. Herndon J. Evans Lodge and Mountain View Restaurant face long Appalachian valley views. Chained Rock, hiking trails, and mountain cottages define the historic mountain-resort experience.

properties.name: Rough River Dam State Resort Park
properties.title: Rough River Dam State Resort Park
properties.history: Resort on Rough River Lake spanning the Breckinridge–Grayson–Hardin border region. Lodge lodging and Grayson's Landing dining serve boaters and golfers on a popular western Kentucky reservoir. The dam and lake are Corps of Engineers projects wrapped by state park amenities.
properties.description: Resort on Rough River Lake spanning the Breckinridge–Grayson–Hardin border region. Lodge lodging and Grayson's Landing dining serve boaters and golfers on a popular western Kentucky reservoir. The dam and lake are Corps of Engineers projects wrapped by state park amenities.

properties.name: Taylorsville Lake State Park
properties.title: Taylorsville Lake State Park
properties.history: Large recreation park on Taylorsville Lake southeast of Louisville. Horse trails, camping, and boat ramps serve Spencer County’s Corps lake. It is a primary weekend escape for Louisville metro visitors.
properties.description: Large recreation park on Taylorsville Lake southeast of Louisville. Horse trails, camping, and boat ramps serve Spencer County’s Corps lake. It is a primary weekend escape for Louisville metro visitors.

properties.name: Waveland State Historic Site
properties.title: Waveland State Historic Site
properties.history: Greek Revival plantation house museum on Lexington’s south side, built by the Bryan family tied to Daniel Boone’s kin. Tours interpret antebellum Bluegrass plantation life and architecture. The landscaped grounds are a compact urban historic stop.
properties.description: Greek Revival plantation house museum on Lexington’s south side, built by the Bryan family tied to Daniel Boone’s kin. Tours interpret antebellum Bluegrass plantation life and architecture. The landscaped grounds are a compact urban historic stop.

properties.name: Wickliffe Mounds State Historic Site
properties.title: Wickliffe Mounds State Historic Site
properties.history: Mississippian culture mound center on the Mississippi River bluffs at Wickliffe. Museum galleries and preserved mounds interpret a Native town occupied roughly A.D. 1100–1350. It is a key prehistoric archaeology stop in far western Kentucky.
properties.description: Mississippian culture mound center on the Mississippi River bluffs at Wickliffe. Museum galleries and preserved mounds interpret a Native town occupied roughly A.D. 1100–1350. It is a key prehistoric archaeology stop in far western Kentucky.

properties.name: Yatesville Lake State Park
properties.title: Yatesville Lake State Park
properties.history: Boating and camping park on Yatesville Lake near Louisa in northeastern Kentucky. Open water and forested shoreline support fishing and marina use. The park anchors Lawrence County outdoor recreation along the Big Sandy region.
properties.description: Boating and camping park on Yatesville Lake near Louisa in northeastern Kentucky. Open water and forested shoreline support fishing and marina use. The park anchors Lawrence County outdoor recreation along the Big Sandy region.
